hints.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. logo-design. Changing it changes the page address.
hints.body: Markdown: **bold**, - lists, blank line between paragraphs.
hints.tools: One tool per line, e.g. Adobe Illustrator.
hints.icon: Short icon name, e.g. palette or code.
hints.clientType: e.g. Salon, school, NGO. Do not name the client without permission.
hints.isPersonalProject: Tick for self-initiated or study work; it is labelled as such on the site.
hints.featured: Shown in "Featured work" on the home page.
hints.consentGiven: Required. Never publish a testimonial without the client’s permission.
hints.phone: As it should be shown, e.g. +255 7XX XXX XXX.
hints.whatsappNumber: 255 followed by 9 digits, no + or spaces, e.g. 2557XXXXXXXX.
hints.faq: Questions for the public FAQ page: payment terms, revisions, timelines, file formats, hosting.
hints.intro: Who Panta-wizzy is, background and what drives the work. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
hints.graphicDesign: Shown under "Graphic Design" on the About page.
hints.webDevelopment: Shown under "Web Development" on the About page.
hints.liveUrl: Full address starting with https://, e.g. https://client-site.co.tz. The button is hidden while this is empty.
hints.repoUrl: e.g. https://github.com/your-name/project. Leave empty for private code.
hints.designUrl: e.g. a Behance or Dribbble page, or a shared Google Drive PDF. Starts with https://.
hints.hero_image: Optional wide photo behind the headline (JPG, PNG or WebP, at least 1600 px wide, max 5 MB). The text gets a dark overlay so it stays readable.
hints.aboutTools: One card per tool, shown in this order. Upload the official logo (SVG or PNG with a transparent background works best). Without a logo the card shows the first letter.
hints.lastUpdated: Change this date whenever you make a real change to the text.
hints.privacy: Markdown: "## " starts a heading, "- " a bullet point, **bold**, [link text](https://…). Replace every [TODO] and remove the DRAFT line once a lawyer has checked it.
hints.terms: Same formatting as above. Fill in payment, revisions, ownership and cancellation rules.
hints.cookies: Update this list if you ever add cookies, for example visitor statistics.
hints.whyChooseUs: Short title and one or two sentences each (4 points look best). While this list is empty, the home page shows 4 built-in points.
hints.story: The history of Wizzy Inc, shown on the home page right after the hero. Leave an empty line between paragraphs. While empty, the About page introduction is shown.
hints.foundedYear: For example 2023. While empty, this card is hidden.
hints.headquarters: City and country, for example Dodoma, Tanzania. While empty, this card is hidden.
hints.founderName: The founder's name. While empty, this card is hidden.
hints.impact: Your real numbers only — for example 25+ happy clients, 99.9% uptime, 40 projects completed. With no numbers the section is hidden.
hints.impact_value: For example 25+, 99.9% or 40. The number counts up on the page.
hints.partners: Brands you have worked with (ask them first). Logos: PNG, WebP or SVG. With no partners the section is hidden.
hints.offices: Shown on the home page ("Visit our office") and the Offices page, each with a map.
hints.offices_latitude: On openstreetmap.org, right-click your office and choose "Show address". Copy the two numbers: the first is the latitude (e.g. -6.17221), the second the longitude (e.g. 35.73947).
